title: Bounded TABLECONTENT row-scope margin writer

scope.operation: Serialize one row-scope TABLEFORMAT margin override in a rectangular TABLECONTENT grid.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 AC1027 scalar table: the first row carries one type-2 margin-only style; the second row and all cells use default scopes. ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.source_basis: The current decoder in src/intern/dxftablecontent.h retains a separate type-2 formatted-row scope and the six-value CELLMARGIN payload. Before this change the multi-cell writer rejected every nondefault row scope and emitted writeStyle(2, nullptr). This receipt qualifies only the selected generated serializer profile; it is not a producer-authored source or native-rendering witness.
limits: One row with one type-2 margin-only scope
All six margins are finite and nonnegative
No row border, content-format, custom-data, CELLSTYLEMAP, column-scope or table-scope edit
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no independent producer, native CAD rendering, or DWG output claim.

implementation: Generalize the existing selected margin-scope admission to accept a type-2 row scope while retaining the type-1 cell border profile and default-profile behavior.
Validate each row scope with the multi-cell writer's complete metadata checks.
Emit the selected row style in ROWTABLEFORMAT, including its exact six-value CELLMARGIN block.

physical_wire: Both rows emit TABLEFORMAT type 2; the selected first row emits has-data=1 and margin override flag 1, while the second row remains has-data=0.
The first row emits exactly six ordered group-40 values: 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.625 and 0.75.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh import preserves the first row's type-2 style, has-data state, override flag and all six margins; the second row stays default.
evidence.failure_control: A negative horizontal row margin is refused; an existing destination sentinel, caller metadata and table collection remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the original positive margin permits export on the same adapter; fresh readback returns the selected margin value.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
This receipt does not qualify other row-style properties, other rows or compositions, column/table/CELLSTYLEMAP margins, native rendering, or DWG output.
